title: Removing a range merges it into the range above
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Have a new matrix for this test, matrix A, three ranges: $0.00 to $100.00, $100.01 to $10,000.00, $10,000.01 and up.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Click the Matrices tab on Settings › Pricing.
  2. Click matrix A's name on the Matrices list.
  3. Click Edit.
  4. Point at the second range's delete button.
  5. Click the second range's delete button.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Matrix A is listed.

Step 2:

  • The grid shows three ranges.

Step 3:

  • Delete buttons show at the left of the first and second rows, lined up down the grid.
  • The last range ($10,000.01 and up) has no delete button.

Step 4:

  • A tooltip reads "Remove this range".

Step 5:

  • Two ranges remain: the first now reads $0.00 to 10000 and the last starts at $10,000.01.
